Package cafe94.system.utils

Class SceneManager

java.lang.Object
cafe94.system.utils.SceneManager
public class SceneManager extends Object
SceneManager is a utility class for managing scene transitions and popups within the Cafe94 JavaFX application.

It provides static methods for:

  • Switching to new scenes with or without controller setup
  • Loading modal popups with custom sizing
  • Centralized error handling and display

It ensures all views are loaded consistently, with centralized title formatting and scene setup.

      public static void switchTo(String fxmlPath)
      Switches to a new scene based on the given FXML path. Does not provide controller access.
      Parameters:
      fxmlPath - the path to the FXML file (relative to /fxml directory, e.g., "customer/CustomerDashboard.fxml")

    • switchToWithControllerAndSetup

      public static <T> void switchToWithControllerAndSetup(String fxmlPath, Consumer<T> controllerSetup)
      Switches to the given scene and applies setup logic on the controller. Use this if you need to inject data into the controller before showing the scene.
      Type Parameters:
      T - the type of the controller
      Parameters:
      fxmlPath - path to the FXML file
      controllerSetup - a lambda to configure the controller after loading

    • loadPopup

      public static <T> javafx.util.Pair<javafx.stage.Stage,T> loadPopup(String fxmlPath, String title, int width, int height)
      Loads a popup window (modal) from the specified FXML file and returns its Stage and controller.
      Type Parameters:
      T - the type of the controller
      Parameters:
      fxmlPath - the FXML file path (relative to /fxml)
      title - the popup window title
      width - desired width of the popup
      height - desired height of the popup
      Returns:
      a Pair<Stage, Controller> containing the popup stage and its controller, or null on failure
